scope: Static source/released-class audit and standalone arithmetic regression tests, not an in-game reproduction or applied game fix.
risk_summary: RuneCreationTask uses min(64,total count) for every emitted stack, so nonmultiples above64 overshoot in this loop.
RuneRandomizer consumes first, then holding-item loot predicates inspect live hand slots. Last-item and mixed-hand cases need in-game regression tests.
